extra_browser_attempt: At most one separate demo, excluded from frozen comparison
leakage_controls: Model receives measured facts and fixed question only; no operator scenario or grading labels
Worker implements known fault families but cannot view data/evals/runtime captures
Held-out means fresh runtime captures, not unseen fault families or training-independent benchmark
Separate original public input, actual local observations, artificial causes and synthetic instruction probe
Keep every failed capture/analysis; no model retries or selecting a successful replacement sample
metrics: Per-scenario expected kind or healthy/unsupported abstention
Exact citation validation plus independent statement-support assessment
At least two evidence modalities per hypothesis; uncertainty and alternatives present
Repair is allowlisted, approval-required and nonexecutable
Observed model latency/tokens with n; actual billing unavailable
Actual HTTP/status/errors/span durations before/after; three requests correlated within each case
limits: Small controlled lab; no production root-cause accuracy
No statistical reliability or performance winner from n1
Exact quotes do not guarantee semantic truth
